source_semantics.summary: The Site Settings source exposes two localized submit controls: Save changes for the site profile form and Save and test for the WordPress credential form.
source_semantics.canonical_collision_note: The source census truncates both localized Text expressions to the same canonical signature @(L.IsArabic ?, so one canonical visible-control operation represents both source submit controls.
source_semantics.profile_submit: Localized as حفظ التغييرات / Save changes and submits the existing SaveProfileAsync form.
source_semantics.credential_submit: Localized as حفظ واختبار / Save and test and submits the existing SaveCredentialAsync form.
source_semantics.side_effect_boundary: This closure claims rendered control parity only. The underlying profile and credential mutations remain owned by their existing AIMW-BILL operation IDs.

laravel_adaptation.profile_submit: The real profile POST submit preserves AIMW-BILL-5C15471E4B and adds the localized visible-control marker.
laravel_adaptation.credential_submit: The real credential POST submit preserves AIMW-BILL-723BEA8F1D and adds the localized visible-control marker.
laravel_adaptation.localization: English and Arabic labels follow the active Laravel locale.
laravel_adaptation.read_authority: SiteSettingsReadController resolves authenticated TenantContext, requires tenant.view and sites.view, scopes the Site to the active tenant, and exposes manage forms only to memberships with sites.manage.

state_and_security.loading_error_empty_authority: The controls render only after the guarded Site Settings read succeeds; missing or foreign sites fail before rendering.
state_and_security.read_only_membership: A membership without sites.manage can read Site Settings but does not receive either manage submit control.
state_and_security.foreign_site: A site ID owned by another tenant returns 404.
